CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database
Option Explicit
Dim boolEnter As Boolean

Private Sub Command29_Click()
MsgBox "Apasa pe butonul similar din dreapta randului pe care vrei sa il salvezi!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
End Sub

Private Sub Command30_Click()
MsgBox "Apasa pe butonul similar din dreapta randului pe care vrei sa il listezi!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation

End Sub

Private Sub Data_AfterUpdate()
Explicatie = fMail2021(DLookup("VL", "CFGs", "F='CH' AND CFG='Explicatie'"))
If Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!ValoareTotala > 0 Then Plata = Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub!ValoareTotala

End Sub

Private Sub Data_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Data, "") = "" Then
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

If Month(Data) <> DLookup("Luna", "LunaD", "IDL= " & Forms!prezenta!IDL) And Year(Data) <> DLookup("Anul", "LunaD", "IDL= " & Forms!prezenta!IDL) Then
    MsgBox "Atentie! Documentul de plata TREBUIE sa fie din luna selectata!!!" & vbCrLf & "Pentru a introduce un document de avans, trebuie salvata prezenta pentru luna respectiva!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Explicatie_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Me.Data, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Trebuie sa completezi campul [DATA] mai intai!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Lst_Click()
[TempVars]![IDC] = IDC.value
DoCmd.OpenReport "Chitanta", acViewPreview
End Sub

Private Sub Plata_AfterUpdate()
If Nz(Plata, "") <> "" Then Plata = CInt(Plata)

End Sub

Private Sub Plata_BeforeUpdate(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Me.Data, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Trebuie sa completezi campul [DATA] mai intai!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Rest_AfterUpdate()
If Rest Then
    Explicatie = "Achitat restanta"
Else
    Explicatie = fMail2021(DLookup("VL", "CFGs", "F='CH' AND CFG='Explicatie'"))
End If
End Sub

Private Sub Sav_Click()
If MsgBox("Doresti salvarea chitantei curente?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
Dim NRCHIT As String

Me.Murdar = False
If Me.Dirty Then Me.Dirty = False
Me.Murdar = True

Dim RC As DAO.Recordset, TC As DAO.Recordset
Dim Bkm As Variant

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM tmpPlatiChitante WHERE ID = " & Me!ID)

If Not POP(RC) Then
    MsgBox "Eroare la salvare!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If RC!Salvata Then
    MsgBox "Chitanta este salvata deja!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Nz(Explicatie, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Nu poti lasa campul [Explicatie] gol!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Nz(Plata, 0) = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Nu poti salva o chitanta fara suma!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Plati", 2)

TC.AddNew
    TC!IDPL = RC!IDPL
    TC!IDP = RC!IDP
    TC!IDZ = RC!IDZ
    TC!IDS = RC!IDS
    TC!IDL = RC!IDL
    TC!Data = RC!Data
    TC!Plata = RC!Plata
    TC!TIP = RC!TIP
    TC!Valid = True
    TC!Restanta = RC!Restanta
TC.Update

Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("Chitante", 2)

TC.AddNew
    TC!IDC = RC!IDC
    TC!IDPL = RC!IDPL
    TC!Data = RC!Data
    TC!Serie = RC!Serie
    TC!Numar = RC!Numar
    TC!Explicatie = RC!Explicatie
    TC!Valoare = RC!Plata
TC.Update

ActualizeazaCamp "CFGS", "VL", RC!Numar + 1, "F='CH' AND CFG='NUMAR'"

If Forms!prezenta!Inchisa Then
    Set TC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM SS_Buget WHERE IDZ=" & Forms!prezenta!IDZ, 2)
    TC.Edit
        TC!Plata = TC!Plata + RC!Plata
        TC!Compensare = IIf(TC!SID > 0, 0, IIf(TC!Plata + TC!Plati > 0, IIf((TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati)) < 0, 0, TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati)), IIf(TC!SIC > TC!ValoareContract, TC!ValoareContract, TC!SIC)))
        TC!Anticipat = IIf((TC!Plata + TC!Plati - TC!ValoareContract - TC!SID) > 0, TC!Plata + TC!Plati - TC!SID - TC!ValoareContract, 0)
        TC!Detalii = TC!Detalii & ";Ch:" & RC!Numar
        TC!SFD = IIf((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)) > 0, (TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)), 0)
        TC!SFC = IIf((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0)) < 0, Abs((TC!SID - TC!SIC) + TC!ValoareContract - (TC!Plata + TC!Plati - Nz(TC!Retur, 0))), 0)
        If TC!Compensare > 0 Then If TC!SIC > 0 And TC!SFD > 0 Then TC!Compensare = TC!SIC
    TC.Update
End If

If MsgBox("Chitanta a fost salvata cu succes!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti listarea acesteia?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbYes Then
    [TempVars]![IDC] = IDC.value
    DoCmd.OpenReport "Chitanta", acViewPreview
End If

Bkm = Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset.Bookmark
Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)
'Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset.Bookmark = Bkm

IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing
Set TC = Nothing

Murdar = False

End Sub

Private Sub Fact_Click()
If Forms!prezenta!Facturi.SourceObject <> "" Then Forms!prezenta!Facturi.SourceObject = ""

If DCount("IDA", "AlteDoc", "IDPL=" & IDPL) + DCount("IDB", "BonuriF", "IDPL=" & IDPL) = 0 Then
    MsgBox "Nu ai introdus datele platii, deci factura nu poate fi generata!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Exit Sub
End If

With Forms!prezenta
    !Facturi.Width = 9696
    !Facturi.Top = !Prezenta_sub.Top
    !Facturi.Height = !Prezenta_sub.Height + !Plati.Height + 90
    !Facturi.SourceObject = "Facturi"
    !Facturi.visible = True
    .InsideWidth = !Grupe.Width + !Prezenta_sub.Width + 9696 + 240
End With

End Sub


Private Sub Form_AfterInsert()
If Murdar Then
    If MsgBox("Nu ai salvat documentul!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti sa il salvezi?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbYes Then
        MsgBox "Apasa pe discheta din dreapta randului!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Else
        Me.Recordset.FindFirst "IDPL = " & CL
        Me.Recordset.Delete
        Murdar = False
    End If
End If

End Sub

Private Sub Form_BeforeInsert(Cancel As Integer)
If Nz(Forms!prezenta!IDP, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Alege copilul caruia vrei sa ii inregistrezi o plata!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

If Forms!prezenta!IDL + 1 < DMax("IDL", "Prezenta") Then
    MsgBox "Nu se mai pot adauga documente decat in luna prezenta sau anterioara!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Cancel = True
    Me.Undo
    Exit Sub
End If

IDPL = Nz(DMax("IDPL", "Plati"), 0) + 1
IDZ = Forms!prezenta!IDZ
IDP = Forms!prezenta!IDP
IDS = DLookup("IDS", "Platitori_sub", "Activ=True AND IDP=" & IDP)
IDL = Forms!prezenta!IDL
TIP = "2"
IDC = Nz(DMax("IDC", "Chitante"), 0) + 1
Serie = Nz(DLookup("VL", "CFGS", "CFG='Serie'"), "Serie")
Numar = CDbl(Nz(DLookup("VL", "CFGS", "CFG='Numar'"), 0))

CL = IDPL

Murdar = True

End Sub
Private Sub Form_Current()
If Nz(Murdar, False) Then
    Me.Recordset.FindFirst "IDPL=" & CL
    Exit Sub
End If

Murdar = False

CL = Nz(Me.IDPL, 0)

Forms!prezenta!IDPL = Me.IDPL
End Sub


Private Sub Form_Load()
Murdar = False
GolesteTabel , "Plati", "Valid=False"
Plata.Enabled = True
Data.Enabled = True
Explicatie.Enabled = True

End Sub


Private Sub Plata_MouseUp(Button As Integer, Shift As Integer, x As Single, y As Single)
    With Plata
        .SetFocus
        .SelStart = 0
        .SelLength = Len(.Text)
    End With
End Sub

Private Sub Del_Click()
On Error GoTo Eroare

Dim RC As DAO.Recordset
Dim Bkm As Variant

If DCount("IDF", "Facturi", "IDPL=" & IDPL & " AND Anulata=False") <> 0 Then
    MsgBox "Plata selectata are factura activa atasata!" & vbCrLf & "Aceasta nu poate fi stearsa!", vbOKOnly + vbCritical
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Anulata Then
    MsgBox "Chitanta selectata este anulata!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    GoTo IESIRE
End If

If Forms!prezenta!IDL + 1 < DMax("IDL", "Prezenta") Then
    MsgBox "Nu se pot anula documente decat in luna prezenta sau cea anterioara!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
    Exit Sub
End If

If CBool(Nz(DLookup("VL", "CFGS", "F='XX' AND CFG='CodAnulare'"), False)) Then
    Dim Cod As String
    Cod = InputBox("Completeaza codul pentru anulare!" & vbCrLf & "Valoare 1: " & Me.Numar & vbCrLf & "Valoare 2: " & Me.Data, "Anuleaza document...", "")
    If Cod <> MakeCod(Me.Numar, Me.Data) Then
        MsgBox "Codul nu corespunde!" & vbCrLf & "Anulare esuata!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
        Exit Sub
    End If
End If

Dim Motiv As String
Motiv = InputBox("Completeaza motivul pentru care anulezi documentul curent!", "Motivul anularii")
If Nz(Motiv, "") = "" Then
    MsgBox "Documentele NU pot fi anulate fara motiv!", vbOKOnly + vbExclamation
    Exit Sub
End If

If MsgBox("Chitantele NU pot fi sterse, decat anulate!" & vbCrLf & "Doresti anularea chitantei " & Serie & "/" & Numar & "?" & vbCrLf & "ATENTIE! ODATA ANULATA, CHITANTA NU MAI POATE FI RESTAURATA!", vbYesNo + vbQuestion) = vbNo Then Exit Sub
        
Anulata = True

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Chitante WHERE IDC = " & IDC, 2)
    RC.Edit
        RC!Anulata = True
    RC.Update

Set RC = CurrentDb.OpenRecordset("SELECT * FROM Plati WHERE IDPL = " & IDPL, 2)
    RC.Edit
        RC!Anulata = True
        RC!motivul = Motiv
    RC.Update

Me.Recalc
        
MsgBox "Chitanta a fost anulata!", vbOKOnly + vbInformation
        
Bkm = Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset.Bookmark
Call IncarcaPrezenta(True)
Forms!prezenta!Prezenta_sub.Form.Recordset.Bookmark = Bkm
       
IESIRE:
Set RC = Nothing

Exit Sub
   
Eroare:
    DebugPrint Err.Description, "Forms/Plati_Chitante/Del_Click()", True
    Resume IESIRE
End Sub
